references.text: God's original instructions to Moses to make carrying poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold for the ark. Exodus 37:4 describes the fulfillment of this command.
A parallel command to make carrying poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold for the table of showbread, showing the same pattern for holy objects.
Similar construction of carrying poles of acacia wood for the altar of burnt offering, although these were overlaid with bronze instead of gold.
Command to make carrying poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold for the altar of incense, following the same pattern.
The same construction method used for the carrying poles of the table of showbread in the same chapter.
The same construction method used for the carrying poles of the altar of incense in the same chapter.
Describes how the Levites were to carry the ark using the carrying poles when the tabernacle was moved.
Connects the execution (chap. 37) directly to the original divine instruction (chap. 25), emphasizing the importance of obedience.
